llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: run the included Node scripts to call Plausible's API. Before installing, consider the following: (1) you will need to provide a PLAUSIBLE_API_KEY — prefer a read-only or limited-scope key if Plausible supports it; (2) the bundle contains Node scripts, so the agent environment must have a compatible Node runtime (the skill metadata did not declare this); (3) the package's source/homepage are unknown — if provenance and publisher reputation matter to you, review the three small .mjs files (they are short and readable) or only install from a trusted source; (4) ensure you are comfortable the scripts only contact plausible.io (they do), and avoid sharing higher-privilege credentials. If you want extra assurance, run the scripts locally yourself with a throwaway API key to verify behavior before granting the key to any automated agent.
